contract.note: api-v1.4.0 is planned and is not frozen. Do not publish 10.0.0 until the server contract is complete and real evidence promotes this channel.

planned_capabilities: Authorized UDP-only remote control stays the remote path, including device list or code, recent and favorites, local approval, one-time password, fixed password, and explicitly enabled unattended access.
Windows service and session broker for startup, lock screen, sign-in, UAC secure desktop, and session switching is planned and not accepted.
Authorized system-audio playback and bidirectional multi-file transfer with progress, cancel, SHA-256, and cleanup are planned and not accepted.
FRP publishing remains separate: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, and templates for NAS, Home Assistant, Immich, Jellyfin, SSH, RDP, and RTSP are planned and not accepted.
A coordinated 9 to 10 upgrade with backup and recovery is planned. Long-term mixed-version operation is not a supported goal. Migration acceptance is pending.

signing.note: No Authenticode or Apple Developer ID identity is configured. SHA-256 and Sigstore build provenance are not publisher signatures.
